versions.content: For each Structure Implementation Data Type , the RTE Types Header File shall include the corresponding structure declaration as: struct Rte_struct_<name> { <elements> }; where <elements> is the record element specification and <name> is the Implemen- tation Data Type symbol of the Structure Implementation Data Type . For each record element defined by one ImplementationDataTypeElement one record element specification <elements> is defined. The record element specifications are ordered according the order of the related ImplementationDataTypeElement s in the input configuration. Sequent record elements are separated with a semicolon.
